turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and why did Owen find out from his phone?
Funny. My son found out about a zero in the middle of class, and nobody called me first.
We're here because an AI wrote his essay, and I'd bet an AI is writing your side of this meeting too.
I'm sorry? You just said something wrote my son's essay, so show me what you have that says so.
Owen's essay, Hale. What do you have?
